title: Two Abelian Statements Equivalent to the Hodge Conjecture

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep

description: The Hodge conjecture is equivalent to two statements on abelian varieties, and the algebraic locus of a flat Hodge class is the whole base or a meagre set. For every real quadratic field we construct K3 surfaces with that real multiplication on all of whose powers the conjecture holds, and we prove the link classes of Mumford fourfolds algebraic on a dense set of special points. The two abelian statements, and with them the Hodge conjecture, remain open. Paper, Lean 4 file (63 theorems) and Julia checks (665).
